create_geometric_map_state: create a GeometricMapState instance with device, num_environments, map_resolution, map_size_cm, and global_downscaling parameters
init_map_and_pose: initialize global and local map and sensor pose variables for all environments in GeometricMapState
get_obstacle_map: get the local obstacle map as a numpy array for a specific environment index
get_planner_pose_inputs: get the 7-dimensional planner pose inputs combining global pose and local map boundaries
update_global_goal_for_env: update the binary goal map for a specific environment with a policy-chosen goal action
